# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH
    T AS (
        SELECT
            *,
            RANK() OVER (
                PARTITION BY state
                ORDER BY fraud_score DESC
            ) AS rk
        FROM Fraud
    )
SELECT policy_id, state, fraud_score
FROM T
WHERE rk = 1
ORDER BY 2, 3 DESC, 1;
title: Top Percentile Fraud
